tools.name: lookup_brand
tools.description:
Look up one brand, store or company by name: its cited parent company, ownership type, source links and,
    for scored brands, a Shoptegrity composite score (an opinion). Use it for a single known name. Fields without a
    cited source come back null and are listed as withheld. A name Shoptegrity

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description:
List alternatives for one brand that a Shoptegrity editor approved and that have a cited basis. Returns
    an empty list, with a note, when none are approved yet; browse_alternatives lists cited employee-owned,
    cooperative and independent options by category instead. Alternatives are not ranked

tools.name: browse_alternatives
tools.description:
Alternatives to mainstream shopping that have a cited basis: employee-owned, cooperative, credit union,
    B Corp or family-owned sellers. structure filters by kind (for example 'employee-owned', 'cooperative',
    'credit union', 'b corp'); query filters by words in the name or the category it sub

tools.name: find_local_businesses
tools.description:
Local businesses near a US ZIP code or a town and state, such as '55401' or 'Duluth, MN': Shoptegrity's
    directory (co-ops, markets, credit unions; pilot areas) plus independent shops anywhere in the US (books,
    gifts, toys, food, markets, grocery, hardware, clothing, secondhand, outdoors, hom

tools.name: search_top_brands
tools.description:
Search the scored-brand table by name, category and minimum grade, and return a short summary per brand
    (parent company, shareholder payout, grade and ratings where published). Use it to browse; use lookup_brand
    for one known name. An empty result means no match, not a negative finding.

tools.name: lookup_brand_integrity
tools.description:
In-depth cited metrics for one brand: the split of revenue among workers, executives and shareholders,
    labor records, and waste, plus SEC filing figures where they exist. Every field without a cited source is
    null and listed under withheld_claims. Grades and ratings are Shoptegrity opinions.

tools.name: rate_major_retailers
tools.description:
Scorecards for the major retailers Shoptegrity covers (Walmart, Target, Costco, Amazon, Kroger, Dollar General,
    The Home Depot, WinCo Foods, Ace Hardware): parent company, revenue, net income and shareholder payouts from SEC
    filings, and ratings or swaps only where an editor approved them. T

tools.name: get_retailer_swaps
tools.description:
One major retailer's cited financial figures and any editor-approved swap. Takes a retailer name such as
    Walmart or The Home Depot. The swap fields are null until a swap has been approved and cited; the error lists
    the retailers available.

tools.name: check_seller
tools.description:
Shoptegrity's cited ownership signals for a seller or brand name, or a plain statement that it has none
    (not a negative finding). Same data as lookup_brand, phrased for a seller you are about to buy from.

tools.name: responsible_alternatives
tools.description:
Search independent sellers for a product or gift idea, with today's price, a check against recorded
    price history, and any Shoptegrity standing, for gift ideas and holiday shopping. max_price is in USD.

tools.name: check_deal
tools.description:
Judge a sale price against Shoptegrity's recorded daily price history for a Shopify catalog product.
    Flags 'raised_then_lowered' when a price was pushed up before a sale. Works for Black Friday and
    Cyber Monday deals. product_id comes from responsible_alternatives.

tools.name: holiday_shopping_guide
tools.description:
A plan for shopping with integrity on Black Friday, Small Business Saturday, Cyber Monday,
    Giving Tuesday or for holiday gifts: the date, days left, and which Shoptegrity tools to use at each step.
    occasion is black_friday, small_business_saturday, cyber_monday, giving_tuesday, christmas, or

tools.name: check_cart
tools.description:
Check a shopping or gift list: for each item, which scored company it belongs to (if any), the cited
    facts Shoptegrity holds (parent, filings, shareholder payouts) and what is withheld. Items can be products,
    brands or stores, such as 'AirPods', 'Tide pods' or 'Walmart'. Up to 50 items.

tools.name: verified_deals
tools.description:
Products from independent Shopify sellers whose price Shoptegrity recorded dropping below its usual level.
    Shows real drops rather than headline discounts, for Black Friday and Cyber Monday. A drop counts only
    with at least 7 earlier days of recorded prices; prices raised before a sale never
